articles.summary:
### Summary
`toml.parse()` converts integer literals (hex, octal, binary, and decimal) to `BigInt` without first bounding the length of the digit sequence. When a dynamic value was passed through a JSX expression, such as `<script>{value}</script>`, an attacker-controlled value containing `</script>` or `</style>` could terminate the element and inject arbitrary HTML and JavaScript.

documents — did not count comment tokens. A document padded with comments could

Deleting an authentication token through `TokenProxy` silently deletes nothing. The call raises no
exception and reports success, the database row survives, and the token keeps authenticating. Any
application, admin integration or operational script that revokes credentials by calling `.delete()`
on a `TokenProxy` instance believes it has revoked a token that is still live.

articles.title: GHSA: virtualenv: Builtin creation follows linked environment directories
articles.summary:
## Summary

The builtin creator accepts existing directory symlinks through ensure_dir() and writes environment files through those
directories. This permits writes outside the requested destination.

Anthropic's OSS Scanner reported this as `ANT-2026-MUFJEG11` in `virtualenv-20261015-005`, received on 15 October 2026.

## Affected area

Directory preparation before environment files are created.

The deletion error handler obtains permission bits with lstat() but applies them through chmod(), which follows
symlinks. On an eligible unlink failure this can change permissions outside the destination.
